'''Thoradin's Wall''' is a gigantic heavily damaged wall separating the [[Arathi Highlands]] from the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]]. 

==Speculation==
* The purpose and origin of the great wall is unknown, thought it may have been built by King [[Thoradin]] or one of his descendants, perhaps to protect the lands of Arathi from the trolls' onslaught.
* It is unclear why the wall is in ruins. It is possible that the local [[ogre]] and [[troll]] tribes, or even the [[Syndicate]], may be responsible.
